# SMOD radiator transmission cooler failure

## Summary

Send automatic transmission fluid to Blackstone Laboratories and check the resulting lab report for signs of mixed coolant. [t23]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Every step below is supported by the source, but the verifier could not confirm this is the whole procedure. Steps or precautions may be missing; read the source thread before relying on it.

1. Send a sample of the automatic transmission fluid to Blackstone Laboratories for analysis.
2. Check the lab report specifically for signs that coolant has mixed into the oil.

_Procedure reported by [t23]._

## Tips & gotchas

- Keep taking samples periodically to stay on top of the issue instead of immediately installing a bypass or new radiator. [t23]
- Perform a complete drain and fill of Matic S fluid after repair. [t24]

## Common mistakes

- Installing an 'old' style radiator during initial repairs which leads to premature failure shortly thereafter. [t24]
